prompt: If I am editing one of my comments and a new comment is posted, the edit box jumps to a different comment, sometimes one written by someone else.

truth.summary: CommentThread keys CommentItem by array index. Comments are listed newest first, so a new comment shifts every index by one and each CommentItem keeps the local isEditing/draft state of the comment that used to be at its position.

referenceAnswer.cause: CommentItem is keyed by index; prepending a new comment shifts the indexes, so the local edit state stays at the old position and attaches to another comment.

decoyAnswers.cause: The draft is initialised from props only once.
RTK Query refetches comments in a different order.

genieEvidence.notes: react_find_components plus react_inspect_component show which CommentItem instance holds isEditing:true and its props.comment.id, which proves the state moved. Custom hook names in the hook list are reported as 'eval' under webpack's eval source maps.
